launch_slurm_sweep: launch a Hydra sweep job on a SLURM cluster using SlurmLauncher with job overrides
launch_local_sweep: launch a Hydra sweep job locally using LocalLauncher with multiple config overrides
setup_base_launcher: setup a BaseSubmititLauncher with hydra context, task function, and DictConfig
